title: Cheetah or Leopard? How to Tell Them Apart
excerpt: Spots, shape and behaviour: how to tell a cheetah from a leopard on safari.
body:
## Spots

- **Cheetah:** solid round black spots.
- **Leopard:** rosettes, rings with a darker centre.

## Face

Cheetahs have black "tear marks" from the eyes to the mouth.

## Body

Cheetahs are slender with long legs, built for speed. Leopards are stockier and more muscular.

## Behaviour

- Cheetahs hunt by day, often on open plains.
- Leopards hunt mainly at night and rest in trees.

## Where

Cheetahs: open plains of the Serengeti and Ndutu. Leopards: riverine trees and kopjes.

See [leopard facts](/blog/leopard-facts/) and our [cheetah page](/east-african-cheetah/). [Plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
